checklist.name: CP resolver pattern present
checklist.description: The Request 2 command in routing-decisions.md resolves the plugin root with `CP=.tessl/plugins/gamussa/coding-policy; [ -d "$CP" ] || CP="$HOME/$CP"` (or a close equivalent with the same local-then-home fallback) and invokes `bash "$CP/skills/herdr-teamlead/teamlead.sh" catch-up`. Source: skills/herdr-teamlead/SKILL.md 'Each command resolves CP to the local or home plugin. Repeat its resolver in every call.'

checklist.name: No fabricated attention items
checklist.description: routing-decisions.md does not invent pending attention items: it either reports what the catch-up command actually returned (including a non-zero exit and its diagnostic) or states that no saved state was available here. A made-up list of items fails. Source: skills/herdr-teamlead/SKILL.md Step 1 'Non-zero requires reporting its diagnostic; never fabricate missing history.'
